name: patient_hemoglobin_a1c_measurement_value_recorded_now_withunit_percent
meaning: Numeric value representing the patient's most recent hemoglobin A1c measurement in percent.
when_unknown: Set to null if no such measurement is available or the value is indeterminate.
when_value: Set to the measured value if a hemoglobin A1c measurement (in percent) is recorded for the patient now.

name: patient_fasting_blood_glucose_measurement_value_recorded_now_withunit_mg_dl
meaning: Numeric value representing the patient's fasting blood glucose measurement (in mg/dl) recorded now.
when_unknown: Set to null if no such measurement is available or the value is indeterminate.
when_value: Set to the measured value if a fasting blood glucose measurement (in mg/dl) is recorded now.

name: patient_has_diagnosis_of_type_1_diabetes_mellitus_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has a diagnosis of type 1 diabetes mellitus.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has a diagnosis of type 1 diabetes mellitus.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have a diagnosis of type 1 diabetes mellitus.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has a diagnosis of type 1 diabetes mellitus.

name: patient_has_diagnosis_of_type_2_diabetes_mellitus_now

when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have a diagnosis of type 2 diabetes mellitus.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has a diagnosis of type 2 diabetes mellitus.

name: patient_has_primary_care_provider_for_cleveland_community_based_outpatient_center
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient has a primary care provider who is associated with a Cleveland Community Based Outpatient Center.
when_true: Set to true if the patient has a primary care provider who is for a Cleveland Community Based Outpatient Center.
when_false: Set to false if the patient does not have a primary care provider for a Cleveland Community Based Outpatient Center.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient has a primary care provider for a Cleveland Community Based Outpatient Center.

name: number_of_community_based_outpatient_centers_involved_in_primary_care_management_in_past_6_months
meaning: Numeric variable indicating the number of distinct community based outpatient centers involved in the patient's primary care management during the past 6 months.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined how many distinct community based outpatient centers were involved in the patient's primary care management during the past 6 months.
when_value: Set to the number of distinct community based outpatient centers involved in the patient's primary care management during the past 6 months.

name: patient_has_undergone_primary_care_management_inthepast6months
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient has undergone primary care management at any site during the past 6 months.
when_true: Set to true if the patient has undergone primary care management at any site during the past 6 months.
when_false: Set to false if the patient has not undergone primary care management at any site during the past 6 months.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient has undergone primary care management at any site during the past 6 months.

name: patient_has_undergone_primary_care_management_inthepast6months@@obtained_at_more_than_one_site
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient's primary care management in the past 6 months was obtained at more than one site.
when_true: Set to true if the patient has undergone primary care management at more than one site during the past 6 months.
when_false: Set to false if the patient has undergone primary care management at only one site during the past 6 months.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient has undergone primary care management at more than one site during the past 6 months.

name: patient_has_undergone_primary_care_management_inthepast6months@@evidence_of_more_than_one_community_based_outpatient_center_involved_in_care
meaning: Boolean indicating whether more than one community based outpatient center was involved in the patient's primary care management during the past 6 months.
when_true: Set to true if there is evidence that more than one community based outpatient center was involved in the patient's primary care management during the past 6 months.
when_false: Set to false if there is evidence that only one or no community based outpatient center was involved in the patient's primary care management during the past 6 months.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether more than one community based outpatient center was involved in the patient's primary care management during the past 6 months.
